accepted.name: pedigree_base
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "Family_ID" AS family_id,
  "Individual_ID" AS individual_id,
  "Paternal_ID" AS paternal_id,
  "Maternal_ID" AS maternal_id,
  "Gender" AS gender,
  "Phenotype" AS phenotype,
  "Population" AS population,
  "Relationship" AS relationship,
  "Siblings" AS siblings,
  "Second_Order" AS second_order,
  "Third_Order" AS third_order,
  "Other_Comments" AS other_comments
FROM _1000_GENOMES._1000_GENOMES.PEDIGREE
grain: family_id, individual_id (one row per pedigree record)
accepted.description: Canonical projection of PEDIGREE exposing pedigree keys and parent links. Use for family-relationship queries, traversals, and joins to sample metadata. | Use for: Identify trios (child + parents) or other family relationships; Join pedigree to SAMPLE_INFO by individual/sample identifier; Aggregate counts of relationship types by population
